name: Poush Mela
note: Annual fair at Shantiniketan on 7th Poush (mid-December, ~Dec 23-28).

name: Basanta Utsav (Spring Festival)
note: Held at Shantiniketan, first day of Bengali Falgun month (mid-March).

name: Baisakhi and Janmashtami Fair
note: Baisakhi confirmed at Nandaprayag; Janmashtami fair NOT found in credible sources.

name: Harela Mela (Monsoon Festival)
note: Held at RamLeela Ground, Bhimtal annually July 16-21.

name: Losar (Tibetan New Year)
note: Losar typically Feb-March (lunisolar). Feb correct for most years; 2025 started Feb 28.

name: Bonbibi Mela (Forest Goddess Festival)
note: Major annual celebration is Jatal Puja in Bengali Magh (Jan-Feb), not April.
